class CQueue:
    def __init__(self):
        self.stk1 = []
        self.stk2 = []

    def appendTail(self, value: int) -> None:
        self.stk1.append(value)

    def deleteHead(self) -> int:
        if not self.stk2:
            while self.stk1:
                self.stk2.append(self.stk1.pop())
        return -1 if not self.stk2 else self.stk2.pop()
